tasks.title: The Role of Fungi in Ecosystems
paras: Fungi play a crucial role in ecosystems, often working behind the scenes to decompose organic matter and recycle nutrients. Unlike plants, fungi do not photosynthesize; instead, they obtain energy by breaking down dead plants and animals. This decomposition process is essential for nutrient cycling, as it releases vital elements like nitrogen and phosphorus back into the soil, supporting new plant growth. Their role in nutrient cycling is indispensable for healthy ecosystems. One fascinating group of fungi is mycorrhizal fungi, which form symbiotic relationships with plant roots. These fungi extend the root system of plants, allowing them to access water and nutrients more efficiently. In return, the plants provide the fungi with carbohydrates produced through photosynthesis. This mutually beneficial relationship enhances plant growth and resilience, particularly in nutrient-poor soils. Not all fungi are beneficial. Some pathogenic fungi cause diseases in plants and animals, leading to significant agricultural and ecological impacts. For example, the chytrid fungus has devastated amphibian populations worldwide. Understanding the diverse roles of fungi in ecosystems can help scientists develop strategies to mitigate their negative effects while leveraging their benefits for environmental sustainability.

questions.stem: According to the passage, fungi are beneficial to plants in terms of

options.A: helping plants to decompose organic matter
options.B: making it possible for plants to photosynthesize
options.C: reducing the amount of nitrogen and phosphorus inside plants

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：allowing them to access water and nutrients more efficiently 解析：菌根真菌帮助植物更高效获取水分和养分，促进生长。 选项分析： A. 帮植物分解有机物 —— 是真菌自身功能，不是帮植物做的事，错误 B. 让植物可以光合作用 —— 植物自己光合，真菌不具备此作用，错误 C. 减少植物体内氮、磷 —— 文意相反，真菌是释放养分，错误 D. 帮助植物获取营养 —— 完全对应原文，正确

questions.stem: The word "indispensable" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：词汇题 原文定位：Their role in nutrient cycling is indispensable for healthy ecosystems. 解析：indispensable 意为不可或缺的、至关重要的。 选项分析： A. similar 相似的 —— 不符 B. well-known 著名的 —— 无关 C. essential 必不可少的 —— 同义替换，正确 D. useful 有用的 —— 程度太轻，不如 essential 精准

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the passage as a process performed by fungi?

options.B: Releasing nitrogen and phosphorus into the soil
options.C: Forming important relationships with plant roots

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：细节排除题 原文定位：fungi do not photosynthesize 解析：真菌不能光合作用，无法自己制造食物。 选项分析： A. 分解有机物 —— 第一段原句，排除 B. 向土壤释放氮、磷 —— 第一段有提及，排除 C. 与植物根系形成共生关系 —— 第二段内容，排除 D. 自己生产食物 —— 真菌不光合，无法自产食物，正确

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the diverse roles of fungi?

options.A: This diversity makes fungi especially difficult for scientists to understand.
options.B: This diversity is considered to be important for the ongoing health of the environment.
options.C: This diversity will decline when harmful fungi are eliminated.
options.D: This diversity has been linked to the sustainability of amphibian populations.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：推理判断题 原文定位：Understanding the diverse roles…mitigate negative effects while leveraging benefits for environmental sustainability 解析：真菌功能多样，对生态环境健康与可持续发展非常重要。 选项分析： A. 多样性让科学家很难理解 —— 文中无难以研究之意，错误 B. 这种多样性对环境持续健康很重要 —— 贴合结尾主旨，正确 C. 消灭有害真菌后多样性会下降 —— 原文无此推断，错误 D. 多样性和两栖动物数量可持续相关 —— 仅举一例蛙类真菌，不能笼统推断，错误

questions.stem: What can be inferred about mycorrhizal fungi?

options.A: They compete with plants for carbohydrates.
options.C: They decompose dead plants and animals.
options.D: They can cause diseases in plants.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：推理判断题 原文定位：These fungi extend the root system of plants, allowing them to access water and nutrients more efficiently. 解析：菌根真菌延伸植物根系，帮助植物吸收养分和水分。 选项分析： A. 和植物争夺碳水化合物 —— 是互惠关系，不是竞争，错误 B. 帮助植物吸收营养 —— 完全对应文意，正确 C. 分解动植物尸体 —— 这是普通真菌功能，不是菌根真菌特点，错误 D. 会使植物生病 —— 致病真菌是另一类，不是菌根真菌，错误
